basic_details.job_title: TNSRLM Chengalpattu State Resource Person Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihoods Mission Chengalpattu (TNSRLM Chengalpattu ) has announced 1 temporary vacancy for the State Resource Person post, with applications to be submitted by post or in person to the District Project Management Unit, Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihoods Mission Chengalpattu , 2nd Floor, A Block, District Collectorate on or before 21 October 2026. The temporary position has a tenure of 24 months, with a maximum pay of Rs. 25,000 per month and Rs. 1,000 per day up to 10 days per month. Applicants must hold a Post Graduate in Social Work / Social Science / Rural Developm

qualification.details: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Social Work, Social Science, Rural Development, Women's Studies, or related social work fields. | Priority will be given to women and Self-Help Group (SHG) members. Age: Must be between 30 and 45 years as on 01.06.2026. Experience: 10 years of experience working with Self-Help Groups / federations / as a Person / in a social work organization or in rural development projects under government schemes. Language: Ability to write and speak in Tamil and English. Skills: Information exchange skills, coordination, interpersonal relationship management, mobile and application handling. Proficiency in computer usage including Word, Excel, and internet is essential.

selection_process: Eligible candidates will be selected through a Written Test and an Interview.

content_sections.heading: TNSRLM Chengalpattu State Resource Person at a Glance

rows.details: Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihoods Mission Chengalpattu (TNSRLM Chengalpattu )
1 (3 districts per person, 5 persons for 15 districts)
Rs. 25,000/- maximum per month (Stipend Rs. 1,000/- per day up to 10 days, Monitoring Rs. 750/- up to 15 days, TA Rs. 250/- for 15 days)
Post Graduate in Social Work / Social Science / Rural Development / Women's Studies / Social Work fields

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be sent by post or submitted directly in person along with self-attested copies of certificates and documents to the following address: District Project Management Unit, Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihoods Mission Chengalpattu , 2nd Floor, A Block, District Collectorate, Chengalpattu District.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in Social Work, Social Science, Rural Development, Women's Studies, or related social work fields. Priority will be given to women and Self-Help Group (SHG) members. Age: Must be between 30 and 45 years as on 01.06.2026. Experience: 10 years of experience working with Self-Help Groups / federations / as a Person / in a social work organization or in rural development projects under government schemes. Language: Ability to write and speak in Tamil and English. Skills: Information exchange skills, coordination, interpersonal relationship management, mobile and application handling. Proficiency in computer usage including Word, Excel, and internet is essential.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates Self-attested copies of age proof Self-attested copies of experience certificates Other supporting documents regarding eligibility

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be selected through a Written Test and an Interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is this job permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The positions are temporary and have a duration of 24 months under this project.

faq.question: Q2. Are there any allowances paid in addition to the consolidated pay?
faq.answer: The remuneration includes a maximum monthly stipend of Rs. 1,000/- per day up to 10 days, Rs. 750/- per day up to 15 days for monitoring, and Rs. 250/- for 15 days as travel allowance, up to a maximum of Rs. 25,000/-.

faq.question: Q3. Who receives priority in the selection process?
faq.answer: Women and members of Self-Help Groups are given priority during the selection.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit and cut-off date?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 30 and 45 years of age as on 01.06.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What documents must be sent with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must send self-attested copies of certificates and documents supporting their educational qualifications, experience, and age along with the application form.
